gaps.sentence: The band broke ___ in the middle of the song.
If the strike goes ___, deliveries will stop nationwide.
He decided to go ___ for the chess championship.
gaps.explanation: 'Go in for' = take part in a competition.

gaps.sentence: The deal fell ___ at the last minute.
gaps.explanation: fall through = (a plan/deal) fail to happen.

gaps.sentence: Do you get ___ well with your new colleagues?
gaps.explanation: get on (with) = have a good relationship; also get along with (AmE).

gaps.sentence: They put ___ the meeting until everyone could attend.
During the tour she pointed ___ the oldest house in town.
gaps.explanation: point out = mention/draw attention to a fact.

gaps.sentence: Don't ___ up all the milk — we need some for breakfast.
gaps.explanation: use up = finish the whole supply of something.
